g.text: Phases of the Reified RSpaces campaign: the days from the first commit to the closing commit of each phase
S2 (the examples), S5 (the documents) and S6 (the diagrams).
Open: S4 (the FIPS matrix), S8 (the benchmarks), S9 to S11 (close-out).
S3 (the node CLI gate) waits for the repair of the node CLI (decision 86).
P11 follows P10: one pgmcp freeze registers the recipes and runs the
verifier for every active leaf (decision 75), with the final gates.
P12 waits for the readiness signal of F1r3lang (SIG-F): the merge of
F1r3lang, the Rholang 1.4 productions, and TensorLogic.
merge and decisions for every family
P0: backup, restore and ledger record (6f7a80da3)
P2: marker encoding of the syntax (e9812d0e5)
P5: other disciplines and outer stores, joins (418d81d7c)
P6: VectorDB family and ChromaDB backend (8ecc6b786)
P7: temp, seq, HashSet, theories, rehydration (be4e9def3)
P10: formal models, examples, documents, FIPS matrix, benchmarks (in progress)
